label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 075 ]

blocks.text: Reviews on caffeine and conception conflict. One study of 2,817 women found no effect of caffeine on their chances of conceiving, while another of 1,909 women linked more than 300 milligrams of caffeine daily to a delay in conception.
